languages_frameworks: OpenAI-compatible SDK (xAI Grok / OpenAI / Anthropic endpoint, optional)

implemented_capabilities.capability: Column-level blast radius with contracts, tests, jobs, dashboards and owners, each with a cited evidence path
implemented_capabilities.notes: Variable-length DEPENDS_ON*0..8 downstream traversal from a Column, hops to Model, Dashboard, Job (REFRESHES), Contract and Test, owner Teams via OWNED_BY; keeps the shortest path per impacted asset and renders it as an arrow string. Handles typos (did_you_mean via difflib and graph names) and returns found=false instead of guessing.

Cypher list-comprehension fragments project a path into plain id/label/name and src/dst/type maps so results do not depend on driver Path objects; make_path orients each edge to produce human-readable evidence text; requires_graph returns an explicit empty_graph error rather than misleading empty results.

implemented_capabilities.capability: k shortest explanation paths (FalkorDB algo.SPpaths) with fallback
implemented_capabilities.notes: CALL algo.SPpaths({sourceNode, targetNode, relTypes, relDirection:'both', maxLen, pathCount}); falls back to shortestPath on older servers; ownership edges excluded by default so unrelated people do not appear connected.

Pure Cypher: failing tests on refreshed models, upstream suspect models and the ingestion jobs feeding them (REFRESHES -> DEPENDS_ON* -> READS_FROM <- WRITES_TO), contracts involved, downstream dashboards, owners with on-call people, and similar past incidents.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Incident memory (write-back and recall) in the graph
implemented_capabilities.notes: record_incident MERGEs an Incident node, links TRIGGERED_BY job, VIOLATED contracts and RELATED_TO the two most similar prior incidents; similar_incidents ranks by 1/shortestPath-hops plus keyword overlap (token set, no embeddings). No decay, no supersession, status is set open and never updated by code.
CALL algo.pageRank('Model','DEPENDS_ON') or algo.betweenness({nodeLabels, relationshipTypes}) joined to downstream dashboard counts and owner, plus shortest dashboard-to-asset evidence paths.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Tool-calling agent loop with deterministic offline router
implemented_capabilities.notes: With a key an OpenAI-compatible model selects among 7 tools and must cite returned paths (prompt-enforced abstention); without a key a regex/keyword router templates answers. Evidence discipline is a system prompt plus tool-level found=false semantics, verified by one opt-in live-LLM test.
Live /schema introspects labels, relationship types and label-[type]->label counts; static vis-network page renders returned evidence paths.
Deterministic synthetic graph (111 nodes, 248 edges, 11 labels) loaded from CSV with UNWIND; clearly disclosed as synthetic in DISCLOSURE.md.

graph_models_and_cypher: Graph 'acme'. Labels: Source, Table, Column{fqn,data_type}, Model, Dashboard, Contract{spec,version,status}, Test{status}, Job{status,last_error}, Incident{severity,root_cause,resolution,status}, Person{on_call}, Team. Edges: READS_FROM, WRITES_TO, HAS_COLUMN, DEPENDS_ON (Column->Column and Model->Model), DISPLAYS, REFRESHES, GOVERNED_BY, OWNED_BY, MEMBER_OF, TRIGGERED_BY, VIOLATED, RELATED_TO. FalkorDB-native: algo.SPpaths, algo.pageRank, algo.betweenness, shortestPath, db.labels()/db.relationshipTypes(), GRAPH.RO_QUERY for all reads. All user values passed as $params; only constant MAX_HOPS and constant rel-type strings are f-string interpolated. No APOC/GDS.
algorithms: Depth-capped (8) downstream lineage closure with shortest path per impacted asset (tools/lineage.py:_shortest_per_target)
algo.pageRank / algo.betweenness criticality joined to dashboard reach (critical_assets)
Graph-distance + keyword-overlap incident similarity score 1/hops + token overlap (similar_incidents)
difflib.get_close_matches fuzzy suggestion over graph ids/fqns/names (client.suggest)
backend_interfaces: CLI: lineagegate seed | serve | ask [--show-tools] | impact | owners | path
frontend_interfaces: Single static page api/static/index.html (150 lines) using vis-network: chat panel, evidence graph, Data model tab
agent_or_memory_mechanisms: Seven Cypher tools exposed as OpenAI function specs; Incident nodes persisted and recalled across sessions via graph traversal (no vector store); offline deterministic router fallback; abstention rules in the system prompt (never invent paths). No multi-agent coordination.
tests_present: tests/: test_hardening.py (10), test_ops_tools.py (8), test_impact_queries.py (7), test_api.py (4) = ~29 pytest tests against a live seeded FalkorDB (typos, ambiguity, empty graph, no-path, evidence paths); one live-LLM abstention test gated by XAI_API_KEY and RUN_LLM_TESTS. Not executed by auditor.
security_findings: src/lineagegate/api/app.py:47-51 - POST /chat is unauthenticated and triggers paid LLM calls and, if the model chooses record_incident, a graph write; there is no rate limit (public Fly demo). Writes are prompt-gated ('only when user explicitly asks'), not code-gated.

src/lineagegate/tools/ops.py:144-170 - record_incident writes arbitrary caller/LLM-supplied title/root_cause text into the graph (stored prompt-injection vector when later returned to the LLM by similar_incidents).
src/lineagegate/graph/client.py:119 - suggest() interpolates the label into Cypher (WHERE n:{label}); all callers pass constant labels ('Column','Job').
src/lineagegate/seed/load.py:40 - label from CSV filename interpolated in CREATE (n:{label}); data directory is trusted repo content.
src/lineagegate/tools/lineage.py:13-60 - MAX_HOPS interpolated into variable-length patterns (constant 8).
deploy/start.sh - FalkorDB bound to 127.0.0.1 inside the image (good); docker-compose.yml exposes 6379 and 3000 with no password and the unpinned :latest tag.

src/lineagegate/agent/loop.py:50-62 - outbound LLM calls to api.x.ai / api.openai.com / api.anthropic.com or a user-set LLM_BASE_URL with keys read from environment; .env.example has placeholders only. No eval/exec/pickle/subprocess in application code.
duplicates_or_overlaps: Overlaps blast-radius traversal (data-lineage flavour: column -> model -> dashboard), ownership/on-call lookup, incident memory and critical-asset ranking. Closest siblings are other 'what breaks if X changes' repos; this one is unusually clean about evidence paths and abstention.
evidence_drift_relevance: MEDIUM - Answers 'what breaks if this changes' by traversing dependency edges to Contracts (with version/spec), Tests and Dashboards and returns the exact edge path as evidence, which is a ready-made dependency-invalidation fan-out; it does not persist drift state, version evidence or gate approvals, and incident memory has no supersession.

strongest_reusable_unit.why: Compact, tested pattern for depth-capped downstream impact with per-asset shortest evidence paths rendered as text, plus driver-independent path projection and fuzzy node resolution with explicit not-found semantics. Maps directly to a Kairos evidence-impact query ('which claims, contracts or decisions depend on this changed source') with citable paths.
strongest_reusable_unit.external_runtime_needed: FalkorDB 4.x with algo.* procedures (SPpaths/pageRank/betweenness) for the optional pieces; no LLM key required (offline router)

strategy_rationale: Port the impact/path/ownership tools as a data-lineage and contracts capability pack on Kairos' FastAPI + FalkorDB stack, reusing the path projection helpers as shared utilities. MIT license and an identical stack make adoption cheap; swap the synthetic Acme schema for Kairos entities.
